professionalSummary: Experienced Customer Success Specialist with a proven track record of onboarding distribution‑centre sites, conducting quarterly health checks, driving adoption of automated slot allocation, managing escalations, and documenting limitations and hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights: Onboarded 14 distribution‑centre sites across four customers, tracking milestones such as dock configuration, shift templates, and first automated week.
Conducted quarterly health checks for nine assigned customers, recording actions in account notes.
Increased automated slot allocation usage from 12 to 21 of 32 sites between Q4 and Q2, surpassing the quarterly baseline of 12 sites.
Coordinated escalations with support and product via an escalation board, ensuring resolution and roadmap commitments.
Authored quarter‑end account notes detailing open limitations and hand‑over points for account managers.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Adoption dashboard export showing automated allocation per quarter with baseline line; includes verification identifiers.
Quarter‑end account note sample highlighting limitations and hand‑over points.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience and achievements in onboarding, health checks, adoption metrics, escalation coordination, and documentation, but do not provide independent verification of all metrics or evidence of performance against broader organizational goals.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate’s evidence supports all role requirements but further verification is recommended.

evidence.text: Onboarded fourteen distribution‑centre sites across four customers onto the scheduling product, tracking each site's milestones (dock configuration, shift templates, first automated week) in the onboarding tracker.
Ran the quarterly health check with each of my nine assigned customers, walking through slot utilisation and open tickets and recording agreed actions in the account notes.

Automated slot allocation was in use at 21 of my 32 assigned sites at the end of Q2, up from 12 of 32 at the end of Q4 the previous year, according to the customer success adoption dashboard against the team's quarterly baseline of 12 sites.
evidence.notes: Shows adoption increase relative to baseline.

evidence.text: Coordinated escalations with support and product through the escalation board; fixes and roadmap commitments were decided by the product manager.
Wrote the quarter‑end account notes for each customer, listing open limitations (for example sites still on manual dock booking) and the hand‑over points for the account manager.
